messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: HIGH priority - elevated 5xx rate detected on gateway-prod. Error rate > 3% over the last 2m. Paging Jen (oncall) and SRE-Lead.

Jen (oncall): I'm on call, looking now. Can someone paste quick query for the affected endpoints?

Rajiv: attaching a quick aggregation — spike centered on /v1/generate fanout to model-pool. 90% of 5xx are 502/504 from upstreams.

Olivia: logs from edge (abridged):
```
2026-03-15T02:12:34Z gateway-prod edge-1 ERROR upstream=worker-12 502 "Bad gateway" request_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate seq=345
2026-03-15T02:12:35Z gateway-prod edge-3 ERROR upstream=worker-08 504 "Timeout" request_id=abc124 path=/v1/generate seq=346
```

Olivia: tracing shows concurrent fanout per request spiked (default parallelism 8 -> many requests caused upstream queueing).

Maya: any customer-visible impact? Are ongoing calls failing or just retries?

Alex (support): We have 3 P1 customer tickets reporting generation failures in US-EAST. Customers report 502/timeout in UI. No major data loss but UX broken for some flows.

Jen (oncall): ok plan: 1) short-term mitigation to reduce upstream fanout (limit parallel upstreams to 2 for /v1/generate), 2) enable short-circuit cache for safe routes, 3) triage root cause. I'll run the mitigation and monitor.

Rajiv: quick check — recent rollout? No deploys in the last 30m. Resource metrics: worker CPU fine, but queue depth on workers is high and connection churn > normal. Suspect a downstream client (model workers) slow responses under high concurrency.

Jen (oncall): applying routing override now. Using ops-router API:
```
POST https://ops-api.internal/v1/routing/overrides
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "overrides": {"max_upstream_parallel": 2, "timeout_ms": 20000},
  "reason": "emergency fanout mitigation"
}
```

Jen (oncall): override applied. Confirming.

Olivia: adding a small circuit-breaker at gateway for upstream 502/504 threshold to fail fast for noisy upstreams. Patch snippet:
```
circuit_breaker:
  max_failures: 5
  window_ms: 60000
  reset_ms: 300000
```

Jen (oncall): circuit-breaker enabled for model-pool group. Monitoring slow roll.

incident-bot: Metric update: 5xx rate dropped from 3.4% to 0.9% in 2m post-override. Latency p50 for /v1/generate improved from 420ms -> 260ms.

Maya: good. Alex — please update affected customers saying we applied mitigations and are monitoring; ETA for full root cause triage later today.

Alex (support): will send status update now.

Rajiv: I'm collecting worker logs and will run deeper profiling. Early hypothesis: a model runtime change increased tail latency under concurrency -> causes connection timeouts upstream. I'll correlate with model onboarding logs.

SRE-Lead: agreed. If confirmed, we'll rollback that model variant or pin routing to lower concurrency model until fix. Also want to add alert tuning: earlier signal when upstream queue depth trend grows for >1m.

Olivia: created temporary dashboard panel for upstream queue depth and per-upstream 5xx. Saved URL: https://dashboards.internal/d/abcd/fanout-triage

Jen (oncall): current status: mitigation holding, 5xx ~0.8%, p95 latency recovering. Handing to Rajiv for daytime follow-up. I'm paged off in 10m.

Rajiv: I'm taking it. Will continue triage and open action items.

Olivia: quick record of commands used for rollback-ish test (for runbook):
```
# lower parallelism for route
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"max_upstream_parallel":2}' https://ops-api.internal/v1/routing/overrides

# enable cb
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"circuit_breaker":{"max_failures":5}}' https://ops-api.internal/v1/gateway/config
```

SRE-Lead: Post-incident actions to create: 1) Runbook update: add "rapid fanout mitigation" steps (owner: Jen), 2) Alerts: create new alert for upstream queue depth slope > X/min (owner: Rajiv), 3) Customer comms template (owner: Alex), 4) RCA ticket (ENGOPS-2109 assign to Olivia).

Jen (oncall): I'm adding a short-term doc to the runbook channel with exact commands used.

Maya: please also add a follow-up to evaluate default parallelism=8 for this route (maybe reduce default or make adaptive). Owner: Product/Infra (Maya).

Alex (support): sent customer note: "We applied service-side mitigations; request flows should be restored. We'll follow up with a detailed update after RCA."

Rajiv: correlation result — model-pool worker logs show GC pauses + network stalls starting ~02:10Z; a particular worker image had a new runtime patch applied yesterday. Opening ENG-ops ticket to consider rolling that image back.

SRE-Lead: fine. Let's avoid urgent rollback unless confirmed causing impact. Use sticky pin to route traffic away from offender pool. Rajiv, please put mitigation to route around flagged workers.

Rajiv: routing rule to avoid worker-hostnames matching worker-08, worker-12 applied.

incident-bot: Update: no new pages for 18m. Team indicates degraded -> mitigated state.

Jen (oncall): handing off formally to Rajiv for follow-up. I'll add my notes to the incident channel and update oncall log.

Rajiv: action items summary (brief):
- ENG-ops-2110 (RCA for model runtime tail latency) -> Olivia (owner)
- ALERT-1342 (upstream queue depth slope alert) -> Rajiv (owner), threshold TBD
- RUNBOOK-ADD-004 (rapid fanout mitigation commands + comms) -> Jen (owner)
- CUSTOMER-COMMS-789 -> Alex (owner)
- EVALUATE-PAR-001 (default parallelism policy) -> Maya/Product (owner)

Olivia: noted. I've already created ENG-ops-2110 and linked dashboard and logs.

Alex (support): copying support ticket IDs to jira: SUP-556, SUP-557, SUP-558.

SRE-Lead: good work. We'll meet for 30m postmortem at 11:00 local to align RCA and runbook edits. Please add notes to incident doc.

Jen (oncall): :thumbsup: thanks team.

Rajiv: closing the live thread. Will keep this thread updated with RCA link and patch decisions.

incident-bot: This incident thread marked as mitigated by Jen (oncall) at 1923457399."
